title: Arecanut — Varieties, Seedling Selection and Planting
content:
ARECANUT VARIETIES (Karnataka):
Mangala, Sumangala, Sreemangala (CPCRI improved varieties — high yielding).
Mohitnagar (CPCRI, suitable for humid tropics).
Local varieties: Sirsi local, Shivamogga local (popular in traditional plantations).

SEEDLING SELECTION:
- Select round, plump, medium-sized nuts from healthy mother palms (15-20 years old, high yielding).
- Mother palms: 5-6 bunches/year, 150+ nuts/bunch.
- Germinate nuts in sand beds with 50% shade.
- Seedling age for transplanting: 6-8 months (nursery) — should have 3-4 leaves.
- Nursery bed: Treat with Bordeaux mixture 1% to prevent damping off.

SPACING:
- Traditional rectangular: 2.7 x 2.7 m — 1,372 palms/ha.
- Triangular/Hexagonal: 2.7 x 2.7 m — ~1,400 palms/ha (more efficient).
- High density: 3 x 3 m — 1,111 palms/ha (easier mechanization).

PIT PREPARATION:
- Pit size: 90 x 90 x 90 cm.
- Refill with top soil + FYM 20 kg + rock phosphate 100g/pit.
- Allow pit to weather 15-30 days before planting.

PLANTING:
- Best planting time: June-July with onset of monsoon.
- Plant with root ball intact, avoid root damage.
- Apply Trichoderma viride 5g + FYM 1 kg per pit at planting.
- Provide shade (50%) for first 2 years using banana or coconut fronds.

POPULATION:
- 1,400 seedlings/ha including 5% extra for gap filling.
- First harvest expected in 3rd year after planting.
- Full economic yield from 8-10 years onwards.
